navigation.title: Startup animation guide: The intro automatically covers the workbench for about 5 seconds each time a page opens or reloads. Choose Skip intro or press Escape to dismiss it. Reduced motion shows a brief static logo.

titles.zh-CN: 开场动画指南：每次打开或刷新工作台页面时，开场动画会自动覆盖工作台约 5 秒。可以选择「跳过开场」或按 Esc 提前关闭。开启减少动态效果时只会短暂显示静态标志。
